recipes.title: Draw a catchment
recipes.description: Change the width of a river corridor and regenerate an illustrative catchment map. This is authored geometry, not a measured boundary.

recipes.title: Give an idea a voice in type
recipes.description: Turn your words into standalone vector outlines. Change the title or letter size and inspect the exact SVG you made.

recipes.title: Hear a frequency
recipes.description: Create one second of a pure tone, then choose Play to listen. Frequency is cycles per second; this sound is synthesised, not a recording or a conversion of the field model.

recipes.title: Make a material
recipes.description: Generate a reproducible colour, normal and ORM texture set. Colour describes appearance; normals describe surface direction; ORM stores occlusion, roughness and metalness.
